# Codage

> Software studio from Split, Croatia. We build custom web and mobile apps — from the first sketch to production. Small team, high craft: design, development and maintenance in one place, with no hand-offs.

## About
- Name: Codage d.o.o.
- Location: Put gaja 6, 21292 Srinjine, Split, Croatia
- Founder: Petar Vrkić
- Contact: kontakt@codage.hr, +385 98 403 330
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 08:00–16:00

## Services
- Web apps — secure and fast, clean and documented code (React, Next.js, Laravel, Node.js, Spring Boot, Scala, AWS)
- Mobile apps — native and hybrid (iOS, Android, React Native)
- Design & consulting — UI/UX, prototypes, technical audit

## How we work
1. Requirements — we listen, ask, and define the goal together
2. Planning & design — structure and layout before the first line of code
3. Development & testing — short cycles with regular demo sessions
4. Maintenance — monitoring, support and upgrades after launch
